task_name: Build Reflecting Pool Park Next to Skyscraper Cluster for Additional Population Boost

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When you have sufficient Simoleons (23,677) and want to stack a second park's coverage over your high-density residential cluster.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Placing a Reflecting Pool Park (6,000 Simoleons, larger coverage area and 10% boost) on the lower road in front of the left-side skyscraper and apartment buildings overlaps the high-density cluster and adds +51 immediate population (bringing total park boost to +148).
preconditions: Available road frontage adjacent to the residential cluster
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Drag the Reflecting Pool Park onto the road directly below the left residential cluster so its green coverage zone overlaps the skyscraper and surrounding apartments.

steps.briefing: drag the Reflecting Pool Park onto the lower road in front of the left-side residential cluster where the green highlight covers the tall buildings (+51 population).
confirm placement of the Reflecting Pool Park.
